js-easy3-digits-only.alternative: const digitsOnly = text => { let out=""; for(const ch of text) if(ch >= "0" && ch <= "9") out += ch; return out; };

js-reverse-string.alternative: const reverse = text => {const points=Array.from(text), out=[]; for(let i=points.length-1;i>=0;i--) out.push(points[i]);return out.join("");};

js-first-letters.alternative: const firstLetters = words => words.map(word => word ? String.fromCodePoint(word.codePointAt(0)) : "");

js-word-count.alternative: const wordCount = sentence => {let count=0, inside=false;for(const ch of sentence){const whitespace=/\s/.test(ch);if(!whitespace&&!inside)count++;inside=!whitespace;}return count;};
